dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 小南，明天上午来我家喝咖啡吧！
dialogue.reading: Xiǎonán, míngtiān shàngwǔ lái wǒ jiā hē kāfēi ba!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: Qī diǎn yī kè, hǎo ma?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: Tài zǎo le! Jiǔ diǎn sān kè ba.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 太晚了！差一刻九点，好吗？
dialogue.reading: Tài wǎn le! Chà yī kè jiǔ diǎn, hǎo ma?
